description: Clock offset between a consumer camera and a dedicated audio recorder, determined by ambient-audio cross-correlation
method: 16 kHz mono audio from both devices, normalized, correlated with scipy.signal.fftconvolve. Coarse pass with wide windows, then narrow search windows (3-15 s) around the approximate offset for precision.

findings.regime_change: sudden: the camera re-synced its clock to a phone during a ~13 h recording gap, and the phone's clock was itself about an hour off

first_regime.description: camera clock ahead by 306.1 s; includes a missed daylight-saving transition (the camera stayed on standard time after the local change)

second_regime.description: camera clock ahead by ~3608 s after the phone re-sync
second_regime.note: 3608000 ms adopted as the reference value: independently verified and within measurement noise

transition.how_confirmed: every clip around the gap was tested against both candidate offsets; exactly one produced a confident match per clip

precision_notes: Wide-window correlation over an hour of ambient audio achieves only ~10-15 s precision and produces spurious peaks from repeating background noise. Narrow windows (3-15 s) around a known approximate offset resolve to the sample and give consistent results.
